claims.text: The hotel is steps from the Duomo di Milano and the adjacent Piazza del Duomo.

findings.quote: Stay steps from Duomo di Milano and the adjacent Piazza del Duomo

claims.text: The hotel is off the Duomo stop on the Metro.

findings.quote: The hotel is also off the Duomo stop on the Metro

claims.text: The hotel occupies an 18th-century palazzo.

findings.quote: The property, which takes up residence in an 18th-century palazzo

claims.text: La Cupola is the hotel's all-day dining outlet.

findings.quote: La Cupola is the all-day dining outlet of the hotel

claims.text: The gastronomic restaurant Pellico 3 Milano was redesigned in 2022 and is led by chef Guido Paternollo.

findings.quote: The gastronomic restaurant Pellico 3 Milano is the ideal location to enjoy a culinary experience in a bright and welcoming setting.
Redesigned in 2022, the restaurant carries on a concept of lightness and balance under the guidance of a new young chef, Guido Paternollo.

claims.text: Chef Guido Paternollo's cooking at Pellico 3 Milano draws on places and traditions of the Mediterranean area.

findings.quote: Pellico 3 Milano is managed by the young and talented Executive Chef Guido Paternollo: his culinary philosophy draws inspiration from different places and traditions of the Mediterranean area

claims.text: AQVAM Spa powered by Beautick offers massages, a whirlpool and steam rooms.

findings.quote: Discover pure relaxation at AQVAM Spa powered by Beautick, your oasis in the heart of Milan. Indulge in exclusive massages, unwind in the whirlpool and steam rooms
findings.note: massages, whirlpool, steam rooms all named

claims.text: The rooms' neutral color palette takes inspiration from the Duomo Cathedral.

findings.quote: the neutral color palette creates a unique connection taking inspiration from the Duomo Cathedral

claims.text: The Terrace Suites, Montenapoleone Suite and Duomo Suite have panoramic terraces overlooking the city skyline.

findings.quote: its Terrace Suites, Montenapoleone Suite and Duomo Suite stand out for their exclusive and evocative panoramic terraces overlooking the city skyline

claims.text: The Montenapoleone Suite has a central double-sided fireplace framed in bronze.

findings.quote: The suite’s lavish decor includes a central double-sided fireplace framed in bronze

claims.text: In spring and summer Mio Lab extends to an outdoor patio called Dehors.

findings.quote: In the spring summer, the space extends to a patio outside, called Dehors
findings.note: space refers to Mio Lab in the CNT review

claims.text: Marble used throughout the property was sourced from Italian quarries.

findings.quote: I was particularly awed by the rainbow of marble used throughout the property, from black-and-white Breccia Medicea to emerald Verde Alpi, all of it sourced from Italian quarries.

claims.text: La Cupola Lounge sits beneath a nine-meter-tall glass cupola.

findings.quote: the stunning La Cupola Lounge welcomes guests to unwind at all hours of the day beneath its nine-meter-tall glass cupola.

claims.text: Mio Lab is the hotel's cocktail bar, a space overlooking the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.

findings.quote: Mio Lab is the renowned cocktail bar at Park Hyatt Milano, an elegant space overlooking the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.

claims.text: The Duomo Suite has a private terrace with a hot tub and views of the Duomo Cathedral.

findings.quote: Step onto the private terrace, complete with a hot tub, and admire breathtaking views of the Duomo Cathedral.

claims.text: The toiletries carry a signature scent created for the hotel by Florentine perfumer Lorenzo Villoresi.

findings.quote: toiletries with a new signature scent created for the hotel by the Florentine perfumer Lorenzo Villoresi

claims.text: Five signature suites were designed by architect Flaviano Capriotti.

findings.quote: five new signature suites designed by the architect Flaviano Capriotti

claims.text: The spa is on the lower floor of the hotel and has three treatment rooms.

findings.quote: makes its home in the lower floor of the hotel, where it has three treatment rooms

claims.text: Standard rooms can be a tight squeeze for three or more; junior suites and up suit families.

findings.quote: Standard rooms might be a tight squeeze for groups of three or more, but everything from a junior suite and up can accommodate families well.

claims.text: Parking is in an off-site indoor garage with valet service.

findings.quote: Park Hyatt Milan is pleased to offer indoor parking at an off-site parking garage for guests and their visitors. Our 24-hour parking garage offers valet service
